Download `flit.rs.zip` for the compiled website built for `https://flit.rs`.

Extract its contents into the domain's web root. The archive includes both languages, optimized assets, sitemap, robots file, and the static Serbian redirect. No Node or Bun runtime is required on the server.

Configure permanent HTTP redirects on the host as described in the repository README. The included `_redirects` file only applies to hosts that support that format.

This release provides the files for uploading to flit.rs. GitHub Pages is deployed separately using its own URL.
